confidence_notes: Meals, coffee and beer are best supported, from search-result summaries of current Gold Coast cost-of-living indexes and guides (not July-specific), some of which look older than their labels. The cocktail rests on one guide. wine_glass is scaled from the local beer relationship because no current restaurant glass price was verified. The four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July winter school-holiday demand, not checked against live listings or booking pages. FX uses the most recent RBA figure found in search (2026-03-20); a newer RBA daily rate may exist and was not verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Food and drink anchors reflect Gold Coast and Surfers Paradise price data; accommodation anchors reflect general knowledge of Gold Coast tourist accommodation.
